brief.title: First Batch, Torn Open
brief.prompt: Seven in the morning, the first tray just pulled and cooling beside the shop's east-facing window. A single salt roll sits low in the bottom-right third on a blackened, well-seasoned steel sheet pan, torn in half by hand so the honeycomb crumb faces the lens; the pool of cultured butter that leaked during the bake has caramelised into a lacy brown ring on the pan around it, and that ring carries the only warm accent in the frame. Coarse grey salt crystals, a few knocked loose onto the steel. One end of the crust is a shade too dark from sitting near the oven door — leave it. The pan's near edge is cut hard by the bottom of the frame, a soft crumpled square of unbleached linen half in shot at right. Camera at counter height, slight downward tilt, focus on the torn crumb only, pan edge and linen falling away. Upper-left stays empty, pale plaster wall softly lit. Composition leaves clean negative space in the upper-left third for a headline.

Three things only, clustered in the lower-right two-thirds: a block of cultured butter on its torn wax-paper wrapper with the corner shaved off in a long curl by a knife that has already left — one pale scrape mark on the paper; a small chipped white enamel dish, rim showing dark iron where the enamel flaked, holding a rough heap of coarse Korean sea salt, one pinch spilled onto the wood; and a scoop of stone-milled domestic wheat flour dumped straight onto the counter in a soft mound with a thumb-sized divot in it, no bowl. The butter block's edge is nearest the window and throws a long soft shadow to the right. Focus on the salt and the cut edge of the butter, flour mound slightly soft. Entire upper-left third is bare counter, lightest part of the wood. Editorial still-life photography, one cohesive series, shot on medium format with a 80mm lens. Color grading: warm neutral base, a single accent hue close to #b45309, low saturation, no neon. Lighting: soft directional window light from the left, bright and airy, gentle long shadows, no flash. Texture: fine film grain, matte surfaces, shallow depth of field on the subject only. No people, no faces, no hands, no body parts anywhere in the frame. No text, no letters, no signs, no logos, no watermarks, no frame or border. Composition leaves clean negative space in the upper-left third for a headline.
brief.negative: no people, hands or body parts; no text, letters, logos or printed labels on the butter wrapper or anywhere; no knife or extra tools in frame; no more than three props; no bowls or measuring cups; no bread in this frame; no glossy melted or sweating butter; no perfectly cubed factory butter; no pristine unmarked counter; no symmetrical or centred arrangement; no hard flash shadows or multiple light sources; no neon or saturated colour; no CGI or render finish; no frame, border or watermark

tells: paper covered in scattered butter smears that don't correspond to any action
harder lighting gives a render-look on wood
claude.fix: Wipe the paper to one honest smear and soften the key light.

astra.fix: Remove the ornamental butter loop and photograph a single rough shaving resting naturally against the cut edge.
